desc: Military Armament Corporation proudly presents the 1911 MEUSOC Pistol in .45ACP, inspired by the modified 1911s carried by Marine Corps units during historic operations. Based on the custom work done to WWII firearms in the Marine Corps inventory that were modified modernize the 1911. These blend nostalgic design with modern manufacturing for exceptional accuracy and reliability. Featuring premium components and thoughtful details, it pays homage to the legendary sidearms of elite Marines. Perfect for enthusiasts and collectors, this pistol captures the spirit of a bygone era with a touch of contemporary performance.
